from pathlib import Path
import json,re
event="1791200758-9e01d07d1441"
base=Path.home()/".local/share/prediction-chat-bridge"
msg=None
for d in ("sent","inflight","outbox"):
    p=base/d/f"{event}.json"
    if p.is_file():
        obj=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8",errors="replace"))
        msg=str(obj.get("message") or "")
        break
if msg is None:
    print("UNIQUE_DIFF_NAMES=EVENT_MISSING",flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(42)
m=re.search(r'production worktree differs from canonical source:\s*(\{.*\})',msg)
if not m:
    print("UNIQUE_DIFF_NAMES=DETAIL_MISSING",flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(42)
raw=m.group(1)
try:
    data=json.loads(raw)
except Exception:
    # bounded fallback: extract quoted paths directly from the different array text
    mm=re.search(r'"different"\s*:\s*\[(.*?)\]',raw,re.S)
    vals=re.findall(r'"([^"]+)"',mm.group(1) if mm else "")
else:
    vals=data.get("different") or []
names=[v.rsplit("/",1)[-1] for v in vals]
print("UNIQUE_DIFF_NAMES="+",".join(names)+" || COUNT="+str(len(names)),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(42)
